caution_findings.reason: Rows include PubMed 28855917 / X. appendiculata circumvolans or later-paper targets not supported by this selected 2017 primary source.
Table 1 comparator controls are retained as assay context but not promoted as paper-derived AMP identities.
The paper supports model liposome leakage for Xac-1 and phenotype-level antimicrobial/hemolysis/histamine data, not a precise intact-cell molecular target.
Opened DOCX supplements are MS/MS analysis files for Xac-1/Xac-2; no supplementary activity/toxicity table was recovered or needed for Table 1 repair.
